title: Small steps: Choose one purpose
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: Just do everything I told you.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: A clear expectation is still needed.
practice: choose the most important action for this moment
principle: Reduce competing goals to one safe, teachable priority.
nextSentence: A clear expectation is still needed. First, choose the most important action for this moment.
keyLearning: Reduce competing goals to one safe, teachable priority.
